[[File:DuneLizard-SOC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Dune lizard/Legends|dune lizard]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].]]
'''Lizards''' were reptiles, usually four-legged terrestrial animals. Species of lizards included the [[Dune lizard/Legends|dune lizard]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the [[kamurith]] from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and the [[voritor lizard]] from [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

Other species of lizards found throughout the galaxy included [[acid lizard]], [[andoan marsh lizard]], [[brezak/Legends|brezak]], [[Dark Lizard|dark lizard]], [[dathomir lizard]], [[derbit/Legends|derbit]], [[dune lizard/Legends|dune lizard]], [[feathered lizard]], [[glider (lizard)|glider lizard]], [[husk lizard]], [[leaflizard]], [[lizardfly]], [[lizard crab/Legends|lizard crab]], [[lizard-ant]], [[lizard-rodent]], [[marsh lizard]], [[nuiwit]], [[predator lizard]], [[rock lizard]], [[lizard|rodian swamp lizard]], [[sand lizard]], [[scrub lizard]], [[shimmerlizard]], [[sleen/Legends|sleen]], [[stalker lizard/Legends|stalker lizard]], [[Stinger lizard/Legends|stinger lizard]], [[stump lizard]], [[sun-lizard]], [[thunder lizard]], [[turmil lizard]], [[twilight lizard]] and [[varactyl/Legends|varactyl]].
